NeoSkriptReflectStructImport.name: Import (skript-reflect)
description: Makes Java classes known to the script by their simple names, as skript-reflect's import: does. Each line is a class's full name, optionally followed by as and another name to use for it.
Imports are each script's own: a class imported in one script isn't known in another. A line naming a class that doesn't exist is an error, with skript-reflect's message.
examples:
import:
	java.lang.Math
	org.bukkit.Bukkit
	java.lang.String as JavaString

NeoSkriptReflectExprJavaCall.name: Java Call (skript-reflect)
description: Calls a Java method, reads a field, or makes a new object, as skript-reflect does: target.method(arguments), target.field and new Class(arguments), where the target is an imported class (for static members) or any value.

The member is chosen from the arguments' classes once per call site and kept, so a call costs a direct method handle call, not a reflective lookup. Where several overloads take the arguments, the closest one is chosen: Math.max(3, 7) is the long one.

A method that's missing, arguments no overload takes, or a method that throws give no value and skript-reflect's warning, naming the line; try before the call leaves the warning out. The error is kept for last java error.
Calls run on the trigger's thread. On Folia, a Java call that reads or changes something another region owns breaks Folia's rules, and NeoSkript can't check what Java code does: see the addon's docs.
examples:
set {_point} to new Point(1, 2)
set {_point}.x to 5

NeoSkriptReflectEffJavaCall.name: Java Call Effect (skript-reflect)
description: A Java call on its own line, for what it does rather than what it gives: {_list}.add("a").

NeoSkriptReflectCondJavaCall.name: Java Call Condition (skript-reflect)
description: A Java call as a condition: it passes if the call gives true, as skript-reflect's does.

NeoSkriptReflectExprNull.name: Null (skript-reflect)
description: Java's null, to pass to a method or set a field to: unlike none, it's a value.

NeoSkriptReflectExprJavaType.name: Java Class by Name (skript-reflect)
description: A class from its full name, as text, without importing it. No value if there's no such class.

NeoSkriptReflectExprJavaTypeOf.name: Class Of (skript-reflect)
description: The Java class of a value.

NeoSkriptReflectExprClassReference.name: Class Object (skript-reflect)
description: Class.class: the java.lang.Class of an imported class, or of a primitive (int.class), to pass to a method that takes one.

NeoSkriptReflectExprNewArray.name: New Array (skript-reflect)
description: A new Java array of the given size, of a primitive or an imported class.

NeoSkriptReflectExprArrayAccess.name: Array Element (skript-reflect)
description: An element of a Java array, counted from 0, which can be set.

NeoSkriptReflectExprCollect.name: Collect (skript-reflect)
description: Values as one Java array: [1, 2, 3] is an Object[]. With as and an imported class, the array is of that class.

NeoSkriptReflectExprSpread.name: Spread (skript-reflect)
description: The elements of a Java array, collection, iterator or stream as separate values.

NeoSkriptReflectCondIsInstanceOf.name: Is Instance Of (skript-reflect)
description: Whether values are instances of a Java class, as Java's instanceof.
examples: if {_list} is an instance of List:

NeoSkriptReflectExprMembers.name: Members (skript-reflect)
description: The fields, methods or constructors of a class or of a value's class, as text, as skript-reflect lists them.

NeoSkriptReflectExprMemberNames.name: Member Names (skript-reflect)
description: The names of the fields or methods of a class or of a value's class.

NeoSkriptReflectExprPlugin.name: Plugin Instance (skript-reflect)
description: The running instance of a plugin, by its imported main class or by its name.

NeoSkriptReflectExprEvent.name: Event (skript-reflect)
description: The Bukkit event the trigger is running for, to call its methods.

NeoSkriptReflectExprJavaError.name: Last Java Error (skript-reflect)
description: What the last Java call on this thread threw, or none if it didn't. Each thread has its own, so a Folia region's calls don't see another's.
examples:
try {_list}.get(9)
send "%last java error%" to console

NeoSkriptReflectEvtByReflection.name: Any Bukkit Event (skript-reflect)
description: A trigger for any Bukkit event, by its imported class, including ones Skript has no syntax for and other plugins' events. Several can be listed with or.
examples:
import:
	org.bukkit.event.server.ServerCommandEvent

on ServerCommandEvent:
	send "%event.getCommand()%" to console

javatype.name: Java Type (skript-reflect)
description: A Java class, imported or found by name. Written as its imported name in a script.

null.name: Null (skript-reflect)
description: Java's null as a value scripts can pass.

event.name: Event (skript-reflect)
description: A Bukkit event.

javaobject.name: Java Object (skript-reflect)
description: A Java array, kept as one value.
